capabilities: Replace a pasted URL with a titled Markdown link
Fetch the title from the linked page itself
Title several URLs in one paste
Add titles to bare links in a note with commands
Skip private hosts and fall back to the host name
extras: Core features are free; Pro features (per-site title rules, link formats, folder batches, title refresh, page details as properties) need a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of $5 a month or $15 once plus a GitHub sign-in, and work offline for up to 14 days after a check. Requests go only to the pasted URL's host, never to a link preview service.
problem: A pasted URL stays a bare address, so a note gives no hint of what the link points to until the reader opens it.

relations.evidence: Sign in uses the GitHub device flow.

summary: Paste handler that turns a pasted URL into a Markdown link using the page's own title, fetched directly from the page.
